title: p4-phi: a started session's effort is capped at its starter's, and workflow agents take no level
behaviour: start_session takes an effort at or below the starter's own and ignores a higher one, and a started session's first turn runs on the starter's model when a higher one is asked. No docs page or tool schema states either cap.
source: undocumented; observed in the app's records on 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17, https://github.com/ezexe/p4/issues/66#issuecomment-6948535788
changes_when: start_session starts a session at the model and effort asked above the starter's, or a documented field does; p4 then drops the read-back and set_session_effort step.

title: wiring: the agent entry rewrites the Agent call where SubagentStart adds context
behaviour: Auto mode can deny an Agent call whose input a PreToolUse hook changed with no permissionDecision, and SubagentStart input carries only agent_id and agent_type, with neither the Agent call's prompt nor its tool_use_id.
changes_when: SubagentStart input carries the Agent call's prompt or tool_use_id, or the Agent tool joins the calls a hook may change in auto mode; p4 then ranks at SubagentStart and drops the PreToolUse record and the bind by type.

title: wiring: the SessionEnd entry logs the end inside a shared 1.5 seconds
behaviour: SessionEnd hooks share a budget of 1.5 seconds, and timeouts set on plugin-provided hooks don't raise it.
changes_when: A plugin hook's timeout raises the SessionEnd budget, or a plugin can set it; p4 then does more at SessionEnd than log the end and its reason, and stops reading the app's records for it.

title: wiring: phi.py never reads the parent session's effort
behaviour: start_session takes an effort at or below the starter's own and ignores a higher one, so p4 has to read effort.level from the hook input and cap the levels it hands out.
source: undocumented cap, observed on 2026-11-16 as #66 records; effort.level documented at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#common-input-fields
changes_when: start_session honours an effort above the starter's, or the cap is documented for a start to read; p4 then needs no cap of its own.

title: wiring: notify_when_idle is named nowhere
behaviour: notify_when_idle makes no subscription to a session reached through Claude Desktop's session messaging, and the app's side-sessions-event continuation stops reaching a starter after many automated messages in a row.
changes_when: notify_when_idle subscribes between desktop sessions, or a starter is always continued when a session it started ends a turn; p4 then drops the closing SendMessage it asks of a finished worker.

title: p4-phi: a puppeteer is told to ask ezexe to compact at every boundary, whatever its context holds
behaviour: Compaction runs only for a typed /compact or for auto-compaction; a PreCompact hook can only block it or add instructions, and no tool, hook output or SDK call starts one.
source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#precompact; the rest undocumented, the app's session tools offer clear_session and no compact
changes_when: A tool or a hook output starts a compaction of a session; p4 then compacts a puppeteer at its own ceiling and asks ezexe nothing.

title: p4-phi: a session holding a start request asks ezexe for the same press at every turn ezexe did not begin
behaviour: start_session with initiation user_asked is refused in a turn that another session's message, a background event or a handed task began, so a start such a turn wants is a suggested task card that waits on ezexe's press.
source: undocumented; the app's refusal is filed as https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/109282
changes_when: start_session accepts a start in a turn ezexe did not begin, such as under a standing approval; p4 then has a session make a start it queued behind a busy writer at any turn, and hands no card call for it.

title: p4-phi: a session that is no puppeteer and starts another session's request gets no line, and the ledger names nothing
behaviour: The app nests a started session under the session that called start_session, no tool moves it under another parent, and a session detached to top level cannot be nested again.
source: undocumented; observed in the app's sidebar and records, asked of the app in https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/109282
changes_when: start_session takes the parent to nest the new session under, or a tool reparents a session; p4 then drops the detach, its own reparent and the exception named to ezexe.

title: p4: no plugin writes the Claude Code settings it relies on, so autoMemoryDirectory is set by hand in each checkout
behaviour: autoMemoryDirectory must be an absolute path or start with ~/, a plugin's userConfig goes only to pluginConfigs in the user's settings, and no common hook input field carries the Claude Code version.
changes_when: autoMemoryDirectory takes a project-relative path, a plugin can supply a project setting, or hooks receive the version; p4 then commits one setting for every checkout and drops the per-checkout writer and the binary read.
